summary: Disciplined Growth Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its IPO of 15,000,000 units at $10.00/unit for gross proceeds of $150 million, and a simultaneous private placement of 345,000 private placement units at $10.00/unit to the sponsor, underwriter Maxim Group LLC, and at-risk capital investors for $3.45 million. The units consist of one Class A ordinary share and one right to receive one-fourth of a share upon an initial business combination. This is a standard SPAC formation filing; the company is a blank-check issuer. Watch for the exercise of the underwriters' 45-day over-allotment option and future business combination announcements.
